+function encodeLocalWriteContent(path: string, content: string): string {

+export interface CapturedContentTree {
+	executionRoot: string;
+	repositoryRoot: string;
+	head: string;
+	tree: string;
+	status: StatusEntry[];
+	untracked: string[];
+	untrackedSet: Set<string>;
+	firstTree: string;

+
+function temporaryIndexPath(commonGitDir: string): string {
+	return path.join(
+		commonGitDir,
+		`pao-content-index-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
+	);
+}
+
+/**
+ * 以临时 index 捕获真实内容 tree。
+ *
+ * 临时 index 放在仓库的共同 Git 管理目录，避免在用户工作根制造未跟踪文件；
+ * `writeContentTree` 只 add `PROJECT_CONTENT_PATHSPECS`，因此 .pao、执行锁和日志
+ * 与 status 差分使用同一个内容边界。
+ */
+export async function captureContentTree(
+	executionRoot: string,
+	signal?: AbortSignal,
+	requireRepositoryRoot = false,
+	verifyStable = true,
+): Promise<CapturedContentTree> {
+	signal?.throwIfAborted();
+	const cwd = path.resolve(executionRoot);
+	const repositoryRoot = (await runGit(["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], cwd, signal)).trim();
+	if (!repositoryRoot) throw new Error("git rev-parse --show-toplevel 未返回仓库顶层");
+	if (requireRepositoryRoot && !sameExecutionPath(repositoryRoot, cwd)) {
+		throw new Error("执行根不是仓库根，拒绝从子目录建立不完整内容基线");
+	}
+	const head = (await runGit(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], repositoryRoot, signal)).trim();
+	if (!/^[a-f0-9]{40,64}$/i.test(head)) throw new Error(`无效 HEAD：${head || "(空)"}`);
+	const commonGitDir = (await runGit(["rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir"], repositoryRoot, signal)).trim();
+	if (!commonGitDir) throw new Error("git rev-parse --git-common-dir 未返回共同 Git 目录");
+	const index = temporaryIndexPath(commonGitDir);
+	try {
+		const env = { ...process.env, GIT_INDEX_FILE: index };
+		const firstTree = await writeContentTree(repositoryRoot, env, signal);
+		const firstStatus = await gitStatusEntries(repositoryRoot, signal);
+		if (verifyStable) {
+			const secondTree = await writeContentTree(repositoryRoot, env, signal);
+			const secondStatus = await gitStatusEntries(repositoryRoot, signal);
+			if (firstTree !== secondTree || JSON.stringify(firstStatus) !== JSON.stringify(secondStatus)) {
+				throw new Error("工作树内容在内容树捕获期间发生变化");
+			}
+		}
+		const tree = firstTree;
+		if (!/^[a-f0-9]{40,64}$/i.test(tree)) throw new Error(`无效内容 tree：${tree || "(空)"}`);
+		const untrackedText = await runGit(
+			["ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z", "--", ...PROJECT_CONTENT_PATHSPECS],
+			repositoryRoot,
+			signal,
+		);
+		const untracked = untrackedText.split("\0").filter(Boolean);
+		return {
+			executionRoot: repositoryRoot,
+			repositoryRoot,
+			head,
+			tree,
+			status: firstStatus,
+			untracked,
+			untrackedSet: new Set(untracked),
+			firstTree: tree,
+		};
+	} catch (error) {
+		signal?.throwIfAborted();
+		throw error;
+	} finally {
+		try {
+			await import("node:fs/promises").then(({ rm }) => rm(index, { force: true }));
+		} catch {
+			// 临时索引清理失败不掩盖已取得的主结果；错误在调用处仍需真实暴露。
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+async function writeContentTree(repositoryRoot: string, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<string> {
+	await runGitWithEnv(["read-tree", "HEAD"], repositoryRoot, env, signal);
+	await runGitWithEnv(["add", "-A", "--", ...PROJECT_CONTENT_PATHSPECS], repositoryRoot, env, signal);
+	return (await runGitWithEnv(["write-tree"], repositoryRoot, env, signal)).trim();
+}
+
+async function runGitWithEnv(
+	args: string[],
+	cwd: string,
+	env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
+	signal?: AbortSignal,
+): Promise<string> {
+	const result = await runCardProcess(
+		"git",
+		["-c", "core.quotepath=off", "-c", "core.autocrlf=false", ...args],
+		cwd,
+		Infinity,
+		env,
+		signal,
+	);
+	if (result.code !== 0) throw new Error(result.stderr || `git exited with code ${result.code}`);
+	return result.stdout;
+}
+
+function parseHeader(text: string, name: string): string | undefined {
+	const escaped = name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
+	return new RegExp(`^# ${escaped}: (.*)$`, "m").exec(text)?.[1]?.trim();
+}
+
+function sameExecutionPath(left: string | undefined, right: string): boolean {
+	if (!left) return false;
+	return (
+		pathKey(path.resolve(left).replace(/\\/g, "/")).replace(/\/+$/, "") ===
+		pathKey(path.resolve(right).replace(/\\/g, "/")).replace(/\/+$/, "")
+	);

+async function diffTrees(
+	repoRoot: string,
+	beforeTree: string,
+	afterTree: string,
+	signal?: AbortSignal,
+): Promise<StatusEntry[]> {
+	if (beforeTree === afterTree) return [];
+	const out = await runGit(
+		[
+			"diff",
+			"--name-status",
+			"-z",
+			"--no-ext-diff",
+			"--no-textconv",
+			beforeTree,
+			afterTree,
+			"--",
+			...PROJECT_CONTENT_PATHSPECS,
+		],
+		repoRoot,
+		signal,
+	);
+	const fields = out.split("\0");
+	const entries: StatusEntry[] = [];
+	for (let index = 0; index < fields.length; ) {
+		const status = fields[index++]?.trim();
+		if (!status) continue;
+		const firstPath = fields[index++];
+		if (!firstPath) continue;
+		if (status.startsWith("R") || status.startsWith("C")) {
+			const secondPath = fields[index++];
+			entries.push({
+				状态: status[0] ?? status,
+				文件: `${secondPath ?? firstPath} -> ${firstPath}`,
+			});
+		} else {
+			entries.push({ 状态: status[0] ?? status, 文件: firstPath });
+		}
+	}
+	return entries
+		.filter((entry) => !entry.文件.split(" -> ").some(isDispatchSystemPath))
+		.sort((left, right) => left.文件.localeCompare(right.文件));
+}

+function yamlPlainStaysString(text: string): boolean {
+	try {
+		return parseYaml(text) === text;
+	} catch {
+		return false;
+	}
+}

+/** 含 YAML 特殊字符、或裸排会被解析成非字符串时加双引号；简单中文/字母数字裸排，可读性优先。 */
+export function yamlSafeString(text: string): string {
+	return /^[\w\u4e00-\u9fff.-]+$/.test(text) && yamlPlainStaysString(text) ? text : JSON.stringify(text);
 }

+function parseLatestExecutionVerdict(
+	card: ParsedCard,
+):
+	| {
+			attempt: string;
+			bindingDigest: string;
+			worktreeDigest: string;
+			snapshotDigest: string;
+			beforeTree: string;
+			afterTree: string;
+			verdict: string;
+	  }
+	| undefined {
+	const record = readLatestVerdict(card.body);
+	if (!record) return undefined;
+	const field = (name: string): string | undefined =>
+		new RegExp(`^-\\s*${name}:\\s*(.+)$`, "m").exec(record.原文)?.[1]?.trim();
+	return {
+		attempt: field("尝试") ?? "",
+		bindingDigest: field("关联摘要") ?? "",
+		worktreeDigest: field("工作树摘要") ?? "",
+		snapshotDigest: field("输入快照") ?? "",
+		beforeTree: field("检查前 tree") ?? "",
+		afterTree: field("检查后 tree") ?? "",
+		verdict: record.结论,
+	};

+async function assertDeliveryContentMatchesVerification(
+	card: ParsedCard,
+	cardsDir: string,
+	execution: ResolvedExecutionContext,
+	currentTree: string,
+	_currentHead: string,
+): Promise<{ 原因: string; 消息: string } | undefined> {
+	const verdict = parseLatestExecutionVerdict(card);
+	if (!verdict) {
+		return {
+			原因: "验收证据缺失",
+			消息: `${formatCardNumber(card.card_no)} 拒绝交卷：找不到当前受管验收记录。`,
+		};
+	}
+	if (
+		verdict.verdict === "未过" ||
+		verdict.verdict === "无法机械判" ||
+		verdict.attempt !== String(execution.key.attempt) ||
+		verdict.bindingDigest !== execution.bindingDigest ||
+		verdict.worktreeDigest !== execution.worktree.bindingDigest ||
+		verdict.snapshotDigest !== execution.snapshotDigest
+	) {
+		return {
+			原因: "验收证据不匹配",
+			消息: `${formatCardNumber(card.card_no)} 拒绝交卷：最近验收的 attempt/输入/工作树关联与本次 execution-context 不一致。`,
+		};
+	}
+	if (!verdict.beforeTree || verdict.beforeTree !== verdict.afterTree || verdict.afterTree !== currentTree) {
+		return {
+			原因: "测试后内容变化",
+			消息: `${formatCardNumber(card.card_no)} 拒绝交卷：验收前后 tree 或当前代码 tree 不一致（${verdict.beforeTree || "(缺)"} → ${verdict.afterTree || "(缺)"}；当前 ${currentTree}）。`,
+		};
+	}
+	const diff = await diffAgainstBaseline(
+		baselineSnapshotPath(cardsDir, card.card_no, execution.key.attempt),
+	);
+	if (diff.验收哈希) {
+		const currentHash = createHash("sha256").update(card.frontmatter.acceptance, "utf8").digest("hex");
+		if (currentHash !== diff.验收哈希) {
+			return {
+				原因: "验收声明已变化",
+				消息: `${formatCardNumber(card.card_no)} 拒绝交卷：验收声明在认领后发生变化，须重新验收。`,
+			};
+		}
+	}
+	return undefined;
+}

+async function gitObject(
+	args: string[],
+	cwd: string,
+	signal?: AbortSignal,
+): Promise<{ code: number; stdout: string; stderr: string }> {
+	return runCardProcess(

+		cwd,
+		60000,
+		undefined,
+		signal,
+	);

+async function createControlledDeliveryCommit(
+	card: ParsedCard,
+	execution: ResolvedExecutionContext,
+	baselineTree: string,
+	currentTree: string,
+	options: DeliverOptions | undefined,
+): Promise<ControlledDeliveryResult> {
+	const author = options?.作者 ?? { 名: "pao", 邮箱: "pao@pao.local" };
+	const seq = formatCardNumber(card.card_no);
+	const key = execution.key;
+	const ref = controlledDeliveryRef(key);
+	const resultPath = deliveryResultPath(key);
+	if (existsSync(resultPath)) {
+		const persisted = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resultPath, "utf8")) as PersistedDeliveryResult;
+		if (
+			!samePath(persisted.key.cardsDir, key.cardsDir) ||
+			persisted.key.cardNo !== key.cardNo ||
+			persisted.key.attempt !== key.attempt ||
+			persisted.bindingDigest !== execution.bindingDigest ||
+			persisted.snapshotDigest !== execution.snapshotDigest
+		) {
+			throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_CARD", "同一交卷请求已绑定不同输入", { path: resultPath });
+		}
+		if (persisted.baselineTree !== baselineTree) {
+			throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_CARD", "同一交卷请求的基线 tree 已变化", { path: resultPath });
+		}
+		const sameContent = persisted.deliveryTree === currentTree;
+		return {
+			card_no: card.card_no,
+			交卷: sameContent,
+			提交哈希: persisted.deliveryCommit,
+			提交信息: buildCommitMessage(card),
+			暂存文件: [],
+			...(sameContent ? {} : { 原因: "测试后内容变化" }),
+			消息: sameContent
+				? `${seq} 幂等：交卷对象 ${persisted.deliveryCommit}（${ref}）已存在，未重复提交。`
+				: `${seq} 拒绝重复交卷：交卷对象创建后代码内容又变化，保留原对象并要求重新验收。`,
+			提交Tree: persisted.deliveryTree,
+			提交对象: ref,
+		};
+	}
+
+	const baselineRef = controlledBaselineRef(key);
+	const existingBaseline = await gitObject(
+		["rev-parse", "--verify", `${baselineRef}^{commit}`],
+		execution.repositoryRoot,
+	);
+	let boundaryCommit: string;
+	if (existingBaseline.code === 0) {
+		boundaryCommit = existingBaseline.stdout.trim();
+		const existingTree = await gitObject(["show", "-s", "--format=%T", boundaryCommit], execution.repositoryRoot);
+		if (existingTree.code !== 0 || existingTree.stdout.trim() !== baselineTree) {
+			throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_CARD", "已有交付基线提交的 tree 与本次内容基线不一致", {
+				ref: baselineRef,
+			});
+		}
+	} else {
+		const baselineHead = await gitObject(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], execution.repositoryRoot);
+		if (baselineHead.code !== 0) throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_CARD", "读取交付基线 HEAD 失败");
+		const boundary = await gitObject(
+			[
+				"-c",
+				`user.name=${author.名}`,
+				"-c",
+				`user.email=${author.邮箱}`,
+				"commit-tree",
+				baselineTree,
+				"-p",
+				baselineHead.stdout.trim(),
+				"-m",
+				`PAO ${seq} attempt ${key.attempt} input boundary`,
+			],
+			execution.repositoryRoot,
+			options?.signal,
+		);
+		if (boundary.code !== 0) throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_CARD", `创建交付基线对象失败：${boundary.stderr}`);
+		boundaryCommit = boundary.stdout.trim();
+		const updateBoundary = await gitObject(["update-ref", baselineRef, boundaryCommit], execution.repositoryRoot);
+		if (updateBoundary.code !== 0) {
+			throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_CARD", `保存交付基线对象失败：${updateBoundary.stderr}`);
+		}
+	}
+
+	const message = buildCommitMessage(card);
+	const delivery = await gitObject(
+		[
+			"-c",
+			`user.name=${author.名}`,
+			"-c",
+			`user.email=${author.邮箱}`,
+			"commit-tree",
+			currentTree,
+			"-p",
+			boundaryCommit,
+			"-m",
+			message,
+		],
+		execution.repositoryRoot,
+		options?.signal,
+	);
+	if (delivery.code !== 0) throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_CARD", `创建受控交付对象失败：${delivery.stderr}`);
+	const deliveryCommit = delivery.stdout.trim();
+	const update = await gitObject(["update-ref", ref, deliveryCommit], execution.repositoryRoot);
+	if (update.code !== 0) throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_CARD", `保存受控交付引用失败：${update.stderr}`);
+	const persisted: PersistedDeliveryResult = {
+		schemaVersion: 1,
+		key,
+		bindingDigest: execution.bindingDigest,
+		snapshotDigest: execution.snapshotDigest,
+		baselineTree,
+		deliveryTree: currentTree,
+		deliveryCommit,
+		deliveryRef: ref,
+		capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+	};
+	mkdirSync(dirname(resultPath), { recursive: true });
+	writeFileAtomic(resultPath, `${JSON.stringify(persisted, null, 2)}\n`);
+	return {
+		card_no: card.card_no,
+		交卷: true,
+		提交哈希: deliveryCommit,
+		提交信息: message,
+		暂存文件: [],
+		消息: `${seq} 已生成受控交付对象 ${deliveryCommit}（${ref}）；差异父对象 tree=${baselineTree}，当前 tree=${currentTree}，只含两者内容差，未改动任何宿主 index，未 push。`,
+		提交Tree: currentTree,
+		提交对象: ref,
+	};
 }

+/** 先区分文件不存在、目标不是普通文件和读取失败，避免把所有 catch 都误写成 ENOENT。 */
+function fileReadPreflight(projectRoot: string, absolutePath: string): string | undefined {
+	try {
+		if (statSync(absolutePath).isFile()) return undefined;
+		return `目标不是普通文件（项目根 ${projectRoot}；实际路径 ${absolutePath}）`;
+	} catch (error) {
+		const reason =
+			(error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT"
+				? "ENOENT，文件不存在"
+				: String((error as Error).message).slice(0, 160);
+		return `读取失败：项目根 ${projectRoot}；实际路径 ${absolutePath}；原因 ${reason}`;
+	}
+}
+
+/** `存在` 核对沿用 statSync，区分真正不存在与其他 I/O 失败，且始终报告项目根和实际路径。 */
+function pathExistsForAcceptance(projectRoot: string, absolutePath: string): { exists: boolean; description: string } {
+	try {
+		statSync(absolutePath);
+		return { exists: true, description: `路径存在（项目根 ${projectRoot}；实际路径 ${absolutePath}）` };
+	} catch (error) {
+		const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
+		if (code === "ENOENT") {
+			return {
+				exists: false,
+				description: `ENOENT，文件不存在（项目根 ${projectRoot}；实际路径 ${absolutePath}）`,
+			};
+		}
+		return {
+			exists: false,
+			description: `状态读取失败：项目根 ${projectRoot}；实际路径 ${absolutePath}；原因 ${String((error as Error).message).slice(0, 160)}`,
+		};
+	}

+function currentAttemptReceipt(card: ParsedCard): Receipt | undefined {

+/**
+ * 机械结果的重复调用只做幂等：
+ * - 完全相同的时间和内容不追加；
+ * - 同一时间但内容不同，保留两段并附加序号，避免覆盖历史；
+ * - 时间相同且已有条目时，新记录使用规范时间加序号。
+ */
+function nextVerdictTime(body: string, time: string, section: string): string {
+	const sameTime: string[] = [];
+	const lines = body.split(/\r?\n/);
+	for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index++) {
+		const match = VERDICT_HEADING_PATTERN.exec(lines[index].trim());
+		if (!match || match[1] !== time) continue;
+		let end = index + 1;
+		while (end < lines.length && !/^## /.test(lines[end].trim())) end++;
+		sameTime.push(lines.slice(index, end).join("\n").trim());
+	}
+	if (sameTime.length > 0 && sameTime.includes(section.trim())) return time;
+	return sameTime.length > 0 ? `${time} #${sameTime.length + 1}` : time;
+}
+
+/** 幂等身份只看 attempt 与验收事实；交付状态和排障路径是首次调用的派生信息。 */
+function verdictIdentity(result: AcceptanceResult): string {
+	const lines = [`- 结论: ${result.结论}`, `- 尝试: ${result.尝试}`];
+	for (const item of result.自报未达项 ?? [])
+		lines.push(
+			`- [自报复核] #${item.verification_index} ${item.条件} → ${item.自报结论}（${item.证据 || "无证据"}）`,
+		);
+	for (const item of result.条目结果) {
+		if (item.类型 === "自报") continue;
+		lines.push(`- [${item.类型}] ${item.摘要} → ${item.结果}（${item.说明}）`);
+	}
+	if (result.人话句.length > 0) lines.push(`- 人话句 ${result.人话句.length} 条待主控审`);
+	for (const sentence of result.人话句) lines.push(`- [人话句] ${JSON.stringify(sentence)}`);
+	if (result.越界核查) lines.push(`- 越界核查: ${result.越界核查.结论}（${result.越界核查.汇总}）`);
+	return lines.join("\n");
+}

+/** 人工改完成也核对机械条件和当前回执；保留 owner 明确说明依据的人工验收。 */
+export async function reviewCardForDelivery(
+	cardsDir: string,
+	cardNo: number,
+	options: VerifyCardOptions,
+	basis?: string,
+	acceptedDeviations?: AcceptedDeviation[],
+): Promise<ParsedCard> {
+	const card = loadCard(cardsDir, cardNo);
+	const latest = currentAttemptReceipt(card);
+	if (latest) {
+		validateReceiptContent(card, {
+			尝试号: latest.attempt,
+			时间: latest.time,
+			产物路径: latest.artifact_path,
+			摘要: latest.summary,
+		});
+	}
+	const gate = await selfReportDeliveryGate(card, cardsDir, latest, options.signal);
+	if (gate.阻断) throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_TRANSITION", `拒绝标为已完成：${gate.阻断}`, { 卡号: cardNo });
+	const checked = await verifyCard(cardsDir, cardNo, options);
+	if (checked.result.结论 === "未过")
+		throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_TRANSITION", `拒绝标为已完成：${checked.result.汇总}`, { 卡号: cardNo });
+	const current = checked.result.自报未达项 ?? [];
+	const accepted = acceptedDeviations ?? [];
+	if (current.length > 0 || accepted.length > 0) {
+		for (const deviation of accepted) {
+			if (
+				!Number.isInteger(deviation.attempt) ||
+				!Number.isInteger(deviation.verification_index) ||
+				deviation.verification_index < 0 ||
+				!deviation.condition.trim() ||
+				!deviation.basis.trim()
+			)
+				throw new PaoCardError(
+					"INVALID_TRANSITION",
+					"accepted_deviations 每项都必须填写 attempt、verification_index、condition 和 basis，不能用空项跳过未达条件",
+					{ 卡号: cardNo },
+				);
+			if (deviation.attempt !== card.frontmatter.attempt)
+				throw new PaoCardError(
+					"INVALID_TRANSITION",
+					`accepted_deviations 的 attempt 必须等于当前尝试 ${card.frontmatter.attempt}；收到 ${deviation.attempt}，旧尝试参数不能重放到新尝试`,
+					{ 卡号: cardNo, 当前尝试: card.frontmatter.attempt, 收到尝试: deviation.attempt },
+				);
+		}
+		for (const deviation of accepted) {
+			if (
+				!current.some(
+					(item) => item.verification_index === deviation.verification_index && item.条件 === deviation.condition,
+				)
+			)
+				throw new PaoCardError(
+					"INVALID_TRANSITION",
+					`接受项不属于当前尝试 ${card.frontmatter.attempt} 的自报未达索引与条件：#${deviation.verification_index} ${deviation.condition}`,
+					{ 卡号: cardNo, 尝试: card.frontmatter.attempt },
+				);
+		}
+		const acceptedIndexes = new Set(accepted.map((item) => item.verification_index));
+		if (acceptedIndexes.size !== accepted.length)
+			throw new PaoCardError("INVALID_TRANSITION", "accepted_deviations 不得重复同一 verification_index", {
+				卡号: cardNo,
+			});
+		if (current.length !== accepted.length)
+			throw new PaoCardError(
+				"INVALID_TRANSITION",
+				"accepted_deviations 必须与当前尝试自报未达条件的数量一致，漏项和多项都不能放行",
+				{ 卡号: cardNo },
+			);
+		if (current.some((item) => !acceptedIndexes.has(item.verification_index)))
+			throw new PaoCardError(
+				"INVALID_TRANSITION",
+				"尚有自报未达项未逐项接受；accepted_deviations 必须覆盖当前尝试全部条件",
+				{
+					卡号: cardNo,
+					未覆盖: current
+						.filter((item) => !acceptedIndexes.has(item.verification_index))
+						.map((item) => `#${item.verification_index} ${item.条件}`),
+				},
+			);
+	}
+	if (!checked.result.自动交付) {
+		if (!basis?.trim())
+			throw new PaoCardError(
+				"INVALID_TRANSITION",
+				"尚有人工验收项：请核查成果并填写总验收依据 basis；accepted_deviations 的逐项依据不能代替总 basis",
+				{ 卡号: cardNo },
+			);
+	}
+	if (acceptedDeviations?.length) {
+		const lines = [
+			"",
+			`## owner记录 ${options.时间 ?? nowString()}`,
+			"- 事件: 接受自报未达项",
+			`- owner: ${options.operator}`,
+			`- 尝试: ${card.frontmatter.attempt}`,
+		];
+		for (const deviation of acceptedDeviations) {
+			lines.push(
+				`- 未达项 #${deviation.verification_index}: ${deviation.condition}；接受依据: ${deviation.basis.trim()}（绑定尝试 ${deviation.attempt}）`,
+			);
+		}
+		const note = lines.join("\n");
+		const body = checked.card.body.trim().length > 0 ? `${checked.card.body.trimEnd()}\n${note}\n` : `${note}\n`;
+		writeFileAtomic(checked.card.path, serializeCard(checked.card.frontmatter, body));
 	}
-	return {};
+	return checked.card;
 }

+/** 把派生验收结果追加到卡正文；锁内重读，完全重复时保留原记录且不追加。 */
+async function appendVerdict(card: ParsedCard, result: AcceptanceResult, time: string): Promise<void> {
+	await withFileLock(card.path, () => {
+		const fresh = readCard(card.path);
+		const section = serializeVerdictSection(result, time);
+		const existing = fresh.body.split(/\r?\n/);
+		const identity = verdictIdentity(result);
+		for (let index = 0; index < existing.length; index++) {
+			const match = VERDICT_HEADING_PATTERN.exec(existing[index].trim());
+			if (!match || match[1] !== time) continue;
+			let end = index + 1;
+			while (end < existing.length && !/^## /.test(existing[end].trim())) end++;
+			const stored = existing.slice(index, end).join("\n").trim();
+			if (storedVerdictIdentity(stored) === identity) return;
+		}
+		const headingTime = nextVerdictTime(fresh.body, time, section);
+		const nextSection = serializeVerdictSection(result, headingTime);
+		const body = fresh.body.trim().length > 0 ? `${fresh.body.trimEnd()}\n\n${nextSection}\n` : `${nextSection}\n`;
+		writeFileAtomic(fresh.path, serializeCard(fresh.frontmatter, body));
+	});
 }

+function stateFor(sessionId: string): CaptureState {

+function jsonSize(value: unknown): { 码点: number | null; 字节: number | null } {
+	try {
+		const json = JSON.stringify(value);
+		if (json === undefined) return { 码点: null, 字节: null };
+		return { 码点: Array.from(json).length, 字节: Buffer.byteLength(json, "utf8") };
+	} catch {
+		return { 码点: null, 字节: null };
+	}
+}

+function toolName(value: unknown): string | null {
+	if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
+	const tool = value as { name?: unknown; function?: { name?: unknown } };
+	if (typeof tool.name === "string") return tool.name;
+	return typeof tool.function?.name === "string" ? tool.function.name : null;
+}

+function toolMetrics(
+	payload: unknown,
+): Pick<ProviderRequestMetrics, "工具字段存在" | "工具数" | "工具JSON码点" | "工具UTF8字节" | "工具"> {
+	if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || !Object.hasOwn(payload, "tools")) {
+		return {
+			工具字段存在: false,
+			工具数: null,
+			工具JSON码点: null,
+			工具UTF8字节: null,
+			工具: [],
+		};
+	}

+	if (!Array.isArray(tools)) {
+		return {
+			工具字段存在: true,
+			工具数: null,
+			工具JSON码点: null,
+			工具UTF8字节: null,
+			工具: [],
+		};
+	}
+	const total = jsonSize(tools);
+	return {
+		工具字段存在: true,
+		工具数: tools.length,
+		工具JSON码点: total.码点,
+		工具UTF8字节: total.字节,
+		工具: tools.map((tool) => {
+			const size = jsonSize(tool);
+			return { 工具名: toolName(tool), JSON码点: size.码点, UTF8字节: size.字节 };
+		}),
+	};

+/** 登记时注入的读数来源；三项都缺省为空表/零值，不影响本模块只读语义。 */
+interface RegistrationOptions {
+	getMinisters?: () => MinisterHandle[];
+	getWorkerActivity?: () => readonly ProcessEntry[];
+	getSilenceMinutes?: () => number;
+}
+
 const owners = new Map<string, DesktopOwnerEntry>();
 
+/**
+ * 每个 ExtensionAPI 登记过的会话 id 集合。
+ *
+ * 用 WeakMap：不持有 pi 的强引用（宿主丢弃 pi 后集合随之回收），也不会跨 pi 串号。
+ * 这里只记「这个 pi 名下有哪些会话」，不记别的 pi 的 id——一次登记一个宿主，互不干扰。
+ */
+const piSessions = new WeakMap<ExtensionAPI, Set<string>>();
+
+/** 取（必要时创建）某个 pi 的会话 id 集合。 */
+function sessionsOf(pi: ExtensionAPI): Set<string> {
+	let sessions = piSessions.get(pi);
+	if (!sessions) {
+		sessions = new Set<string>();
+		piSessions.set(pi, sessions);
+	}
+	return sessions;
+}
+
+/** 把某会话的 owner 条目写进 owners，并把该会话 id 记进本 pi 的集合。 */
+function remember(pi: ExtensionAPI, ctx: ExtensionContext, sessionId: string, options: RegistrationOptions): void {
+	owners.set(sessionId, {
+		pi,
+		ctx,
+		getMinisters: options.getMinisters ?? (() => []),
+		getWorkerActivity: options.getWorkerActivity ?? (() => []),
+		getSilenceMinutes: options.getSilenceMinutes ?? (() => 0),
+	});
+	sessionsOf(pi).add(sessionId);
+}
+
+/** 只删「这个 id 确实属于这个 pi」的条目，别人的会话一条都不碰。 */
+function forget(pi: ExtensionAPI, sessionId: string): void {
+	const sessions = piSessions.get(pi);
+	if (!sessions) return;
+	sessions.delete(sessionId);
+	if (owners.get(sessionId)?.pi === pi) owners.delete(sessionId);
+}

+/**
+ * 只定位一份执行对应的会话文件（阶段 7 性能候选 2）。
+ * 增量读取原先每次都要重读整个项目（全部卡、全部映射、全部会话、活性与队列），
+ * 500 份映射时单次净增约 0.55 秒；这里收窄到「只读这一份映射 + 只枚举会话目录」，
+ * 身份检查一条不省：映射文件名＝执行标识、项目根与当前项目一致、卡路径在工作区内且是普通文件、
+ * 会话路径在工作区内、同一执行标识对应多份会话时拒绝任选。
+ */
+function locateExecutionSession(projectRoot: string, executionId: string): string {

+	if (!executionId.trim() || executionId.includes("/") || executionId.includes("\\"))

+	const mappingPath = join(root, ".pao", "执行映射", `${executionId}.jsonl`);

+	} catch (error) {
+		if (isMissing(error)) throw new Error("未找到可读的执行会话，请刷新映射并查看问题列表");

+	}

+	const { rows, pending } = parseLiveJsonl(text);
+	if (pending) throw new Error("执行映射末行尚未写完，等待下次刷新；不推断完成。");
+	const row = rows.at(-1);
+	if (!row) throw new Error("执行映射没有完整记录，请刷新映射并查看问题列表");
+	let declaredRoot: string | undefined;
+	try {
+		declaredRoot = typeof row.项目根 === "string" ? realpathSync(row.项目根) : undefined;
+	} catch {
+		declaredRoot = undefined;
+	}
+	if (
+		typeof row.执行标识 !== "string" ||
+		row.执行标识 !== executionId ||
+		declaredRoot !== root ||
+		typeof row.卡路径 !== "string" ||
+		typeof row.状态 !== "string" ||
+		typeof row.时间 !== "string" ||
+		!Number.isInteger(row.尝试) ||
+		Number(row.尝试) < 1

+		throw new Error("执行映射身份或字段不完整");
+	let cardPath: string;
+	try {
+		cardPath = realpathSync(row.卡路径);
+	} catch {
+		throw new Error("执行映射所指卡不存在或无法读取");
+	}
+	if (!inside(root, cardPath)) throw new Error("执行映射引用其他项目的卡");
+	if (!statSync(cardPath).isFile()) throw new Error("执行映射所指卡不存在或无法读取");
+	const sessionDir = join(root, ".pao", "worker会话");
+	const matches: string[] = [];
+	for (const file of entries(sessionDir, [])) {
+		if (!file.endsWith(".jsonl")) continue;
+		const stem = file.slice(0, -".jsonl".length);
+		for (
+			let underscore = stem.lastIndexOf("_");
+			underscore >= 0;
+			underscore = underscore > 0 ? stem.lastIndexOf("_", underscore - 1) : -1
+		) {
+			if (stem.slice(underscore + 1) === executionId) {
+				matches.push(file);
+				break;
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if (matches.length > 1) throw new Error("同一执行标识对应多份会话，不能任选一份");
+	const name = matches[0];
+	if (!name) throw new Error("未找到可读的执行会话，请刷新映射并查看问题列表");
+	const sessionPath = realpathSync(join(sessionDir, name));
+	if (!inside(root, sessionPath)) throw new Error("worker 会话路径越出所属项目");
+	return sessionPath;
+}

+/** 分层监督的宿主计时默认值:部长查仍在运行的工人,主控查仍有工作的部门。 */
+export const DEFAULT_WORKER_SUPERVISION_MINUTES = 15;
+export const DEFAULT_DEPARTMENT_SUPERVISION_MINUTES = 30;
+
+/**
+ * 分钟监督配置独立读取:文件/键缺失、坏 JSON、非数字或负数都回落默认值;
+ * 显式 0 关闭该级监督,正小数向下取整但最小为 1 分钟。
+ *
+ * 这与旧「轮次监督」是两套兼容口径:分钟监督默认开启,轮次监督仍默认关闭。
+ */
+function readSupervisionMinutes(paoHome: string | undefined, key: string, fallback: number): number {
+	if (!paoHome) return fallback;
+	const raw: unknown = readJsonSafe(join(paoHome, WARM_CONFIG_RELATIVE_PATH));
+	if (typeof raw !== "object" || raw === null || Array.isArray(raw)) return fallback;
+	const value = (raw as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
+	if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value)) return fallback;
+	if (value === 0) return 0;
+	if (value < 0) return fallback;
+	return Math.max(1, Math.floor(value));
+}
+
+/** 读部长检查仍在运行工人的间隔(分钟);缺省 15,显式 0=关。 */
+export function readWorkerSupervisionMinutes(paoHome: string | undefined): number {
+	return readSupervisionMinutes(paoHome, "工人监督分钟", DEFAULT_WORKER_SUPERVISION_MINUTES);
+}
+
+/** 读主控检查仍有工作部门的间隔(分钟);缺省 30,显式 0=关。 */
+export function readDepartmentSupervisionMinutes(paoHome: string | undefined): number {
+	return readSupervisionMinutes(paoHome, "部门监督分钟", DEFAULT_DEPARTMENT_SUPERVISION_MINUTES);
+}

+/** 部门监督对象使用可打印稳定键;活动源与真实部长记录用 digest 合并。 */
+function departmentSupervisionKey(input: { department: string; projectRoot: string; context?: string }): string {
+	const digest = createHash("sha256")
+		.update(`${resolve(input.projectRoot)}\u0000${input.department}\u0000${input.context ?? ""}`)
+		.digest("base64url")
+		.slice(0, 24);
+	return `department:${input.department}:${digest}`;
+}

+/** 查库网络请求的默认等待上限；调用方可在一次查询内缩短它用于界面快速取消。 */
+export const DEFAULT_EMBED_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
+
+/** 原生 AbortSignal 超时单独标记，供查库保留“超时降级、用户取消直接停止”的区别。 */
+export class EmbedTimeoutError extends Error {
+	readonly timeoutMs: number;
+
+	constructor(timeoutMs: number) {
+		super(`嵌入请求超时（${timeoutMs}ms）`);
+		this.name = "TimeoutError";
+		this.timeoutMs = timeoutMs;
+	}
+}
+
+export interface EmbedRequestOptions {
+	signal?: AbortSignal;
+	timeoutMs?: number;
+}
+
+/** 同一次自动路由查询内的查询词嵌入 Promise 缓存；缓存不跨调用、不落盘。 */
+export type QueryEmbeddingCache = Map<string, Promise<number[]>>;
+
+/** 将取消原因转成可抛出的 Error，避免把取消静默当成普通网络失败。 */
+export function abortError(signal: AbortSignal): Error {
+	const reason = signal.reason;
+	if (reason instanceof Error) return reason;
+	const error = new Error("查库已取消");
+	error.name = "AbortError";
+	return error;
+}
+
+export function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
+	if (signal?.aborted) throw abortError(signal);
+}
+
+/**
+ * 等待一次可能不响应 AbortSignal 的异步操作。
+ *
+ * 有些测试替身和第三方 fetch 实现只接收 signal，却不会在取消时自行
+ * 拒绝；因此不能只依赖 fetch 的实现。请求头和 response.json() 都经过
+ * 这里，且 finally 会移除监听器，避免一次查询结束后继续持有调用方的
+ * AbortSignal。
+ */
+function awaitWithAbort<T>(
+	operation: () => PromiseLike<T>,
+	userSignal: AbortSignal | undefined,
+	timeoutSignal: AbortSignal | undefined,
+	timeoutMs: number,
+): Promise<T> {
+	throwIfAborted(userSignal);
+	if (timeoutSignal?.aborted) throw new EmbedTimeoutError(timeoutMs);
+	let cancelled = false;
+	let cleanup = () => {};
+	const abortPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
+		const onUserAbort = () => {
+			cancelled = true;
+			reject(abortError(userSignal!));
+		};
+		const onTimeout = () => {
+			cancelled = true;
+			reject(new EmbedTimeoutError(timeoutMs));
+		};
+		if (userSignal) {
+			if (userSignal.aborted) onUserAbort();
+			else userSignal.addEventListener("abort", onUserAbort, { once: true });
+		}
+		if (timeoutSignal) {
+			if (timeoutSignal.aborted) onTimeout();
+			else timeoutSignal.addEventListener("abort", onTimeout, { once: true });
+		}
+		cleanup = () => {
+			userSignal?.removeEventListener("abort", onUserAbort);
+			timeoutSignal?.removeEventListener("abort", onTimeout);
+		};
+	});
+	const task = Promise.resolve().then(() => {
+		if (cancelled) return new Promise<T>(() => {});
+		return operation();
+	});
+	return Promise.race([task, abortPromise]).finally(cleanup);
+}
+
+function embedConfigKey(config: EmbedConfig): string {
+	return `${config.baseUrl}\u0000${config.apiKey}\u0000${config.model}`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * 同配置、同查询词只复用查询向量 Promise；调用方必须先完成本库外发授权，
+ * 因此这个接缝不会把一个已授权库的权限扩散给禁外发库。
+ */
+export function sharedQueryEmbedding(
+	client: EmbedClient,
+	query: string,
+	cache: QueryEmbeddingCache,
+	options?: EmbedRequestOptions,
+): Promise<number[]> {
+	const key = `${embedConfigKey(client.config)}\u0000${query}`;
+	const existing = cache.get(key);
+	if (existing) return existing;
+	const task = embedTexts(client, [query], options).then(([vector]) => {
+		if (!vector) throw new Error("嵌入端点返回缺少查询向量");
+		return vector;
+	});
+	cache.set(key, task);
+	return task;
+}

+/** 保留文件名：类型区自己的索引与缓存文件不能被条目名撞上。 */
+const RESERVED_ENTRY_FILE_NAMES = new Set(["子索引.md", "索引.md", ".pao-vector-cache.json"]);
+
+/** Windows 保留设备名：带扩展名也仍是设备，落盘会被系统拒绝或行为异常。 */
+const WINDOWS_RESERVED_STEMS = new Set([
+	"con",
+	"prn",
+	"aux",
+	"nul",
+	...Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, index) => `com${index + 1}`),
+	...Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, index) => `lpt${index + 1}`),
+]);
+
+/**
+ * 入库目标文件名必须是「直接属于所选类型区的普通 .md 文件名」（审查第 4 项）。
+ * 此前只校验解析后的绝对路径仍落在整个知识库根内，`../跨区.md` 于是能通过：
+ * 候选文件已被移出原位、子索引写了错链接，用户看到的却是最后巡检抛出的失败。
+ * 这里在移动/建目录/写索引之前就拒绝，保证原文、目标与索引三者都不变。
+ */
+function assertPlainEntryFileName(fileName: string, typeDir: string): void {
+	const reject = (reason: string): never => {
+		throw new Error(
+			`入库文件名不合法（${reason}）：${JSON.stringify(fileName)}；目标必须是「${typeDir}」目录下的普通 .md 文件名`,
+		);
+	};
+	if (fileName.length === 0) reject("空文件名");
+	if (fileName !== basename(fileName)) reject("含目录分隔符");
+	if (/[\\/:*?"<>|]/.test(fileName)) reject("含路径分隔符或 Windows 非法字符");
+	// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- 控制字符必须显式拒绝
+	if (/[\u0000-\u001f]/.test(fileName)) reject("含控制字符");
+	if (fileName === "." || fileName === "..") reject("点路径");
+	if (!fileName.toLowerCase().endsWith(".md")) reject("不是 .md 文件");
+	if (RESERVED_ENTRY_FILE_NAMES.has(fileName.toLowerCase())) reject("是保留的索引/缓存文件名");
+	const stem = fileName.slice(0, -3);
+	if (WINDOWS_RESERVED_STEMS.has(stem.toLowerCase())) reject("是 Windows 保留设备名");
+	if (/[. ]$/.test(stem)) reject("主体以点或空格结尾（Windows 会静默改名）");
+}

+export interface RecallSelection {
+	hits: MemoryHit[];
+	truncated: {
+		hit?: { 记忆ID?: string; 原正文码点: number; 保留正文码点: number };
+		因纠正排除: number;

+function normalizeRecallText(text: string): string {
+	return text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
+}
+
+interface IdentityMemoryHit extends MemoryHit {
+	__paoContentIdentity?: string;
+}
+
+function contentIdentity(hit: IdentityMemoryHit): string | undefined {
+	if (hit.__paoContentIdentity) return hit.__paoContentIdentity;
+	const normalized = normalizeRecallText(hit.内容);
+	return normalized ? `sha256:${createHash("sha256").update(normalized, "utf8").digest("hex")}` : undefined;
+}
+
+function visibleText(content: unknown): string {
+	if (typeof content === "string") return content;
+	if (!Array.isArray(content)) return "";
+	return content
+		.filter(
+			(block): block is { type: "text"; text: string } =>
+				Boolean(block) &&
+				typeof block === "object" &&
+				(block as { type?: unknown }).type === "text" &&
+				typeof (block as { text?: unknown }).text === "string",
+		)
+		.map((block) => block.text)
+		.join("\n");
+}
+
+interface RecallMessageDetails {
+	hits?: MemoryHit[];
+	vendor?: string;
+	memories?: MemoryHit[];
+	provider?: string;
+}
+
+function messageDetails(message: unknown): RecallMessageDetails | undefined {
+	if (!message || typeof message !== "object") return;
+	const details = (message as { details?: unknown }).details;
+	return details && typeof details === "object" ? (details as RecallMessageDetails) : undefined;
+}
+
+interface RecallMessage {
+	message: Record<string, unknown>;
+	kind: "automatic" | "manual";
+	vendor: string;
+	hits: MemoryHit[];
+}
+
+function recallMessage(message: unknown): RecallMessage | undefined {
+	if (!message || typeof message !== "object") return;
+	const value = message as Record<string, unknown>;
+	const details = messageDetails(value);
+	if (value.role === "custom" && value.customType === "pao-auto-recall" && details?.hits && details.vendor) {
+		return { message: value, kind: "automatic", vendor: details.vendor, hits: details.hits };
+	}
+	if (value.role === "toolResult" && value.toolName === "pao_memory_recall" && details?.memories && details.provider) {
+		return { message: value, kind: "manual", vendor: details.provider, hits: details.memories };
+	}
+}
+
+function sameRecallContent(hit: MemoryHit, content: string): boolean {
+	const text = visibleText(content);
+	if (!text) return false;
+	const normalized = normalizeRecallText(hit.内容);
+	return normalized.length > 0 && normalizeRecallText(text).includes(normalized);
+}

+	return messages

+		.filter((text) => text.length > 0)

+/** 终端行数从当前 stdout 读取；测试或非终端宿主没有 rows 时按常见 24 行处理。 */
+function terminalRows(): number {
+	const rows = Number((process.stdout as NodeJS.WriteStream).rows);
+	return Number.isFinite(rows) && rows > 0 ? Math.floor(rows) : 24;
+}
+
+/** 读取当前 TUI 终端行数。overlay 可能运行在非 stdout 的终端上，优先使用 TUI 自己的尺寸。 */
+function tuiRows(tui: TUI): number {
+	const rows = Number((tui as TUI & { terminal?: { rows?: number } }).terminal?.rows);
+	if (Number.isFinite(rows) && rows > 0) return Math.floor(rows);
+	return terminalRows();
+}

+type ConfigState = {
+	status: "missing" | "valid" | "invalid" | "unreadable";
+	reason?: string;
+};
+
+type InspectedConfig = { state: ConfigState; value?: Record<string, unknown> };
+
+/** 只读取配置形状和开关字段，不把参数对象（可能含凭证）显示到界面。 */
+function inspectConfig(
+	path: string,
+	name: string,
+	fields: Record<string, (value: unknown) => boolean>,
+	required: string[] = [],
+): InspectedConfig {
+	if (!existsSync(path)) return { state: { status: "missing" } };
+	let raw: unknown;
+	try {
+		raw = readJsonRaw(path);
+	} catch (error) {
+		if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return { state: { status: "missing" } };
+		const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
+		return {
+			state: {
+				status: code === "EACCES" || code === "EPERM" ? "unreadable" : "invalid",
+				reason: safeConfigReason(name, error),
+			},
+		};
+	}
+	if (typeof raw !== "object" || raw === null || Array.isArray(raw)) {
+		return { state: { status: "invalid", reason: `${name} 配置顶层应为 JSON 对象` } };
+	}
+	const value = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
+	for (const [field, valid] of Object.entries(fields)) {
+		if (
+			(required.includes(field) && value[field] === undefined) ||
+			(value[field] !== undefined && !valid(value[field]))
+		) {
+			return { state: { status: "invalid", reason: `${name} 配置字段「${field}」格式错误` } };
+		}
+	}
+	return { state: { status: "valid" }, value };
+}
+
+/** 配置解析失败只展示固定类别，不把 JSON 解析器可能带出的原文片段回显到 TUI。 */
+function safeConfigReason(name: string, error: unknown): string {
+	const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
+	const missing = message.match(/缺少字段「([^」]+)」/);
+	if (missing) return `${name} 配置缺少字段「${missing[1]}」`;
+	if (/权限|permission|access|EACCES|EPERM|EISDIR|拒绝访问|无法读取/i.test(message))
+		return `${name} 配置无法读取（权限或路径不可读）`;
+	if (/字段|应为|布尔|字符串|对象/.test(message)) return `${name} 配置字段格式错误`;
+	if (/JSON|json|解析|parse|token|position/i.test(message)) return `${name} 配置不是合法 JSON`;
+	return `${name} 配置无法读取`;
+}
+
+function warmConfigState(path: string): InspectedConfig {
+	return inspectConfig(path, "保温", {
+		"toast 通知": (value) => typeof value === "boolean",
+		上游并发上限: (value) => typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 1,
+	});
+}
+
+function memoryConfigState(path: string): { state: ConfigState; value?: MemoryVendorConfig } {
+	try {
+		const value = loadMemoryVendorConfig(path);
+		return value ? { state: { status: "valid" }, value } : { state: { status: "missing" } };
+	} catch (error) {
+		const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
+		const unreadable = /无法读取|权限|permission|access|EACCES|EPERM|EISDIR|拒绝访问/i.test(message);
+		return {
+			state: {
+				status: unreadable ? "unreadable" : "invalid",
+				reason: safeConfigReason("记忆供应商", error),
+			},
+		};
+	}
+}
+
+function stateHint(state: ConfigState, path: string, name: string): string {
+	if (state.status === "missing") return `${name}配置未配置；位置：${path}`;
+	if (state.status === "valid") return "";
+	return `${state.reason ?? `${name}配置异常`}；位置：${path}；面板不会覆盖原文件`;
+}

+/**
+ * 只在一次结果聚合调用内复用相同 Git 查询。
+ * key 同时包含真实工作目录和完整参数，避免不同项目、不同基线或不同排除规则串用结果；
+ * Promise 也缓存失败，保持原有错误说明而不悄悄重跑。
+ */
+function memoizeRunGit(runGit: ResultsRunGit): ResultsRunGit {
+	const pending = new Map<string, Promise<ResultsGitOutput>>();
+	return (args, cwd) => {
+		// 只用真实路径生成缓存键，让同一个项目通过符号链接访问时仍共用
+		// 查询；找不到目录时保留原 cwd 交给 runGit，从而不改变原错误语义。
+		let keyCwd = cwd;
+		try {
+			keyCwd = realpathSync(cwd);
+		} catch {
+			// 缓存键退回原值；真正的目录错误仍由 runGit 报告。
+		}
+		const key = JSON.stringify([keyCwd, args]);
+		const existing = pending.get(key);
+		if (existing) return existing;
+		const current = Promise.resolve().then(() => runGit(args, cwd));
+		pending.set(key, current);
+		return current;
+	};
+}

+/**

+async function settleGateOnce(
+	gate: Extract<DispatchBudgetGateResult, { ok: true }> | undefined,
+	phase: { value: DispatchGatePhase },
+	settle: (gate: Extract<DispatchBudgetGateResult, { ok: true }>) => Promise<string | undefined>,

+	}

+			const failures: string[] = [];
+			let workerText: string;
+			if (workerResult.status === "fulfilled") {
+				const proof = workerResult.value;
+				workerText =
+					proof.stoppedProcesses.length === 0
+						? "无运行中的后台 worker,未停任何 worker 进程;本轮已封锁再派发。"
+						: `已停 ${proof.stoppedProcesses.length} 个进程(后台 worker):${proof.stoppedProcesses
+								.map((p) => `pid=${p.pid}${p.卡号 ? `(卡${p.卡号})` : ""} ${p.方式}`)
+								.join(";")}`;
+			} else {
+				workerText = "后台 worker 全停失败";
+				failures.push(
+					`后台 worker 全停失败:${workerResult.reason instanceof Error ? workerResult.reason.message : String(workerResult.reason)}`,
+				);
+			}
+			let ministerText: string;
+			if (hostResult.status === "fulfilled") {
+				ministerText =
+					hostResult.value.length === 0
+						? "宿主没有登记中的部长会话,未停部长进程。"
+						: `已停 ${hostResult.value.length} 个部长会话。`;
+			} else {
+				ministerText = "部长会话全停失败";
+				failures.push(
+					`部长会话全停失败:${hostResult.reason instanceof Error ? hostResult.reason.message : String(hostResult.reason)}`,
+				);
+			}
+			let trackingText: string;
+			if (trackingResult.status === "fulfilled") {
+				trackingText = "宿主监督跟踪已停止;同一会话内不会自动重启。";
+			} else {
+				trackingText = "宿主监督跟踪停止失败";
+				failures.push(
+					`宿主监督跟踪停止失败:${trackingResult.reason instanceof Error ? trackingResult.reason.message : String(trackingResult.reason)}`,
+				);
+			}
+			const lines = [workerText, ministerText, trackingText, ...failures];
+			return {
+				content: [{ type: "text", text: lines.join("\n") }],
+				details: {
+					workerStopped:
+						workerResult.status === "fulfilled" ? workerResult.value.stoppedProcesses.length : undefined,
+					ministerStopped: hostResult.status === "fulfilled" ? hostResult.value.length : undefined,
+					trackingStopped: trackingResult.status === "fulfilled",
+					failures,
+				},
+				isError: failures.length > 0 ? true : undefined,
+			};
 		},
 	};

+// ── pao_accept_task：完整任务受理窄工具（计划 §5.2） ────────────────────────────────
+//
+// ## 这个工具做什么
+// 一次调用把「集中预检 → 建卡 → 可选派发 → 返回真实身份」做完，逐条给出受理身份或真实拒绝原因。
+// 业务逻辑一行都不在这里：全部交给 `intake/` 的唯一入口 `acceptIntake`。本函数只做三件事——
+// 参数映射、模板解析（复用 cards 模板库）、把 IntakeOutcome 渲染成模型一眼能看懂的文本。
+//
+// ## 旧入口与新入口的关系（**名字与行为都是兼容契约，一律不改**）
+// | 旧入口 | 在新入口里是哪一步 | 什么时候还该用它 |
+// |---|---|---|
+// | `pao_create_card`（建卡） | 第 2 步「建卡」：同一 `createCard`、同一发号器、同一原子写 | 只想建卡不想受理/不需要集中预检与幂等时；手工补建 |
+// | `pao_dispatch_card`（派发） | 第 3 步「派发」：`dispatch=true` 时经同一个 `dispatchInBackground` 走同一条后台链 | 卡已存在、只想派它；指定 `接管`/`cards_dir` 等派发专属参数时 |
+// | `pao_inventory`（查询） | 不在受理链内：受理是写动作，查询仍是查询 | 想看「卡现在什么状态、还有谁在跑」时 |
+// | `pao_terminate_card`（停止） | 不在受理链内 | 停掉运行中的 worker（停完旧受理结果即失效，见下方 §5.4） |
+//
+// 新入口不是旧入口的替代品：它把「建卡＋派发」合成一次调用，并补上幂等判据与集中预检；
+// 旧入口继续可用、语义不变（兼容契约，见计划 §12.2）。
+//
+// ## 停止后旧回执（计划 §5.4）
+// 受理返回的是**当时**的身份快照。之后卡被停掉（canceled）、或重开进入了新尝试（attempt 变化），
+// 这份旧 outcome 就不能再当「成功受理/正在跑」。判断交给 `intake/` 导出的 `isIntakeOutcomeStale`，
+// 本工具的重复提交分支与 `pao_inventory` 的说明文字都会带上这条纪律。
+//
+// ## 幂等判据（不静默变更）
+// 模型没给 `request_key` 时，按「目标＋部门＋验收＋依赖」算稳定摘要（sha256 前 16 位，带 `auto:` 前缀）。
+// 返回文本里一定写明「本次用的判据是什么、是模型给的还是自动生成的」——判据一旦给出就不改写，
+// 同一请求重试会自动落到同一条判据上（幂等＝先到者为准）。
+
+/** 自动判据前缀：一眼区分「模型给的」与「工具按目标摘要生成的」。 */
+const AUTO_INTAKE_KEY_PREFIX = "auto:";
+
+/**
+ * 按「目标＋部门＋验收＋依赖」算稳定判据。
+ *
+ * 为什么只取这四个字段：它们是「这是不是同一个任务」的最小充分集。预算/档位/优先级是执行参数，
+ * 改这些不该变成新任务；inputs/constraints 是正文细节，进来会让判据过度敏感（措辞一变就重复建卡）。
+ * 依赖排序后参与，避免同一依赖集换个顺序被当成新任务。
+ */
+export function buildAutoIntakeKey(parts: {
+	goal: string;
+	dept: string;
+	acceptance: string;
+	dependsOn?: readonly string[];
+}): string {
+	const normalized = [
+		parts.goal.trim(),
+		parts.dept.trim(),
+		parts.acceptance.trim(),
+		[...(parts.dependsOn ?? [])]
+			.map((item) => item.trim())
+			.sort()
+			.join(","),
+	].join("\u0000");
+	return `${AUTO_INTAKE_KEY_PREFIX}${createHash("sha256").update(normalized, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 16)}`;
+}

+export interface AcceptTaskToolDeps {
+	resolveCardsDir: () => string;
+	resolveHome: () => string | undefined;
+	/** 唯一派发通道（registerWorkerTools 闭包里的 dispatchInBackground），只在 dispatch=true 时用 */
+	dispatchInBackground: DispatchInBackground;

+/** 模板名/绝对路径 → 正文骨架。解析实现只在 cards 模板库里，这里只做「有就给」的搬运。 */
+function templateResolver(paoHome: string | undefined) {
+	return (request: IntakeRequest): IntakeTemplateBody | undefined => {
+		const name = request.template?.trim();
+		if (!name) return undefined;
+		// 解析失败（模板找不到/PAO_HOME 缺失）如实抛出，由 acceptIntake 收敛成带真实原因的拒绝
+		const path = resolveCardTemplatePath(name, paoHome);
+		return { name, body: loadCardBodyTemplate(path) };
+	};

+/**
+ * 身份一行：卡号 / 尝试号 / 实例节点轮次——**给不出就不写**，不编。
+ *
+ * 注意「卡」字是**本层拼的显示前缀**，不是 E3 契约的一部分：`IntakeOutcome.cardNo` 是
+ * 纯四位编号 `"0001"`（不含前缀，受理侧已对 `formatCardNumber` 的前缀做过归一）。
+ * 别以为 cardNo 自带「卡」字，也别在别处把 `卡${cardNo}` 的结果当 id 再用一次——
+ * 那是展示串，拿去比对/落库会得到 `卡卡0001`。
+ */
+function identityLine(outcome: IntakeOutcome): string {
+	const parts: string[] = [];
+	if (outcome.cardNo !== undefined) parts.push(`卡${outcome.cardNo}`);
+	else parts.push("无卡号");
+	parts.push(outcome.attempt !== undefined ? `尝试 ${outcome.attempt}` : "尝试号未产生（未启动就没有尝试）");
+	const flow: string[] = [];
+	if (outcome.instance !== undefined) flow.push(`实例 ${outcome.instance}`);
+	if (outcome.node !== undefined) flow.push(`节点 ${outcome.node}`);
+	if (outcome.round !== undefined) flow.push(`轮次 ${outcome.round}`);
+	if (flow.length > 0) parts.push(flow.join("/"));
+	return parts.join("，");
+}
+
+/** 问题项逐条一行（不吞问题、不概括成「有风险」）。 */
+function problemLines(outcome: IntakeOutcome): string[] {
+	return outcome.problems.map(
+		(item) =>
+			`  · [${item.level}] ${item.subject}：${item.reason}${item.suggestion ? `（建议：${item.suggestion}）` : ""}`,
+	);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Outcome → 模型可读文本。四种状态各说各的真话，尤其是 duplicate 不许只说「重复了」。
+ *
+ * `stale` 由调用方算（要对磁盘再查一次卡），undefined 表示「没查/不适用」。
+ */
+export function formatIntakeOutcome(
+	outcome: IntakeOutcome,
+	options: { cardsDir: string; autoKey: boolean; stale?: boolean; requestKey: string },
+): string {
+	const keyLine = `请求判据：
+${options.requestKey}（${options.autoKey ? "工具按『目标＋部门＋验收＋依赖』自动生成，未给则沿用此判据" : "调用方提供，原样保留"}）`;
+	const lines: string[] = [];
+	switch (outcome.status) {
+		case "accepted": {
+			lines.push(`已受理：${identityLine(outcome)}`);
+			lines.push(`受理时间：${outcome.acceptedAt}`);
+			if (options.stale === true) {
+				// 受理后到渲染这段文本之间，卡已被停/被重开——不能再说「在等你查」
+				lines.push("注意：这张卡已被停止或重开（旧受理结果不再有效，别把它当成功；以 pao_inventory 的现场为准）。");
+			}
+			lines.push("后续：用 pao_inventory 查它现在什么状态；要停就调 pao_terminate_card。");
+			break;
+		}
+		case "duplicate": {
+			const first = outcome.duplicateOf;
+			lines.push("这是同一请求的重复提交，已返回第一次受理的身份，未重复建卡。");
+			if (outcome.cardNo !== undefined) {
+				lines.push(`首次受理身份：${identityLine(first ?? outcome)}`);
+			} else {
+				lines.push(
+					"首次身份不可得：受理账里这条判据没有记下卡号（账可能被改坏或卡已被删），请用 pao_inventory 核对现场。",
+				);
+			}
+			lines.push(`首次受理时间：${first?.acceptedAt ?? outcome.acceptedAt}`);
+			if (options.stale === true) {
+				// §5.4 的同一条纪律也管重复提交：首次那张卡已被停/被重开，
+				// 「已返回第一次的身份」就不再等于「它还在跑」——必须当场说清，否则等于用旧身份报成功。
+				lines.push(
+					"注意：首次那张卡已被停止或重开（旧受理结果不再有效，别把它当成功；以 pao_inventory 的现场为准）。",
+				);
+			}
+			lines.push("没有新建卡、没有重复派发；如果你要的是新任务，请换一条判据（request_key）。");
+			break;
+		}
+		case "deferred": {
+			lines.push(`已受理并建卡，但没有派发：${identityLine(outcome)}`);
+			lines.push(`推迟原因：${outcome.reason ?? "原因未记（宿主没给）"}`);
+			lines.push("卡是真的建好了（可以用 pao_inventory 查到）；等条件满足后可用 pao_dispatch_card 派出。");
+			break;
+		}
+		case "rejected": {
+			lines.push("未受理：没有建卡，卡目录没有新增文件。");
+			lines.push(`原因：${outcome.reason ?? "原因未记（受理未给出）"}`);
+			break;
+		}
+	}
+	const problems = problemLines(outcome);
+	if (problems.length > 0) lines.push(`问题项 ${problems.length} 条：`, ...problems);
+	lines.push(keyLine);
+	return lines.join("\n");
+}

+function buildAcceptTaskTool(deps: AcceptTaskToolDeps): ToolDefinition<typeof AcceptTaskParams> {
+	return {
+		name: "pao_accept_task",
+		label: "受理任务",
+		description:
+			"完整任务受理：一次调用做完「集中预检→建卡→可选派发」，直接返回受理身份（卡号/尝试号）或**真实拒绝原因**。" +
+			"与旧入口的关系（旧入口名字与行为都不变，继续可用）：本工具的第 2 步就是 pao_create_card 的建卡、" +
+			"第 3 步就是 pao_dispatch_card 的派发；查询仍用 pao_inventory，停止仍用 pao_terminate_card。" +
+			"dispatch 缺省 false——受理默认不替你花钱，要立刻跑必须显式 dispatch=true 且给 reason。" +
+			"尝试号由后台派发产生，工具返回时刻可能尚未产生（文本会写「尝试号未产生」，不是失败）；要权威的当前身份与尝试号，用 pao_inventory 复查。" +
+			"幂等：request_key 是请求判据，同一判据重复提交返回第一次的身份、不重复建卡；不给则按『目标+部门+验收+依赖』自动生成并在返回里写明。" +
+			"停止/重派后旧受理结果即失效（计划 §5.4），别拿旧 outcome 当成功。",
+		parameters: AcceptTaskParams,
+		execute: async (_toolCallId, params: AcceptTaskParamsShape, _signal, _onUpdate, ctx) => {
+			const cardsDir = params.cards_dir ?? deps.resolveCardsDir();
+			const paoHome = deps.resolveHome();
+			if (!paoHome) {
+				return toolError(
+					"受理未执行：缺 PAO_HOME（集中预检要读部门注册表/档位/预算配置，空 home 不跑；请在装配时给 resolvePaoHome 或设 PAO_HOME 环境变量）",
+				);
+			}
+			const explicitKey = params.request_key?.trim() ?? "";
+			const requestKey =
+				explicitKey.length > 0
+					? explicitKey
+					: buildAutoIntakeKey({
+							goal: params.target,
+							dept: params.dept,
+							acceptance: params.acceptance,
+							dependsOn: params.depends_on,
+						});
+			const autoKey = explicitKey.length === 0;
+			const dispatch = params.dispatch === true;
+			const request: IntakeRequest = {
+				// IntakeRequest 的字段是 ASCII 英文契约名；卡片协议的中文 frontmatter 键在 intake 内映射，本层不碰
+				idempotencyKey: requestKey,
+				goal: params.target,
+				dept: params.dept,
+				acceptance: params.acceptance,
+				...(params.inputs !== undefined ? { inputs: params.inputs } : {}),
+				...(params.constraints !== undefined ? { constraints: params.constraints } : {}),
+				...(params.depends_on !== undefined ? { depends_on: params.depends_on } : {}),
+				...(params.tier !== undefined ? { tier: params.tier as CardTier } : {}),
+				...(params.budget !== undefined ? { budget: params.budget as CardBudget } : {}),
+				...(params.priority !== undefined ? { priority: params.priority as CardPriority } : {}),
+				...(params.template !== undefined ? { template: params.template } : {}),
+				dispatch,
+				...(params.reason !== undefined ? { reason: params.reason } : {}),
+			};
+			try {
+				const report = await acceptIntake(cardsDir, [request], {
+					paoHome,
+					dispatchInBackground: deps.dispatchInBackground,
+					resolveTemplate: deps.resolveTemplate ?? templateResolver(paoHome),
+					// 会话 id 随派发注入 workflowCheck 做实例 owner 重核（与 pao_dispatch_card 同源）
+					...(ctx?.sessionManager?.getSessionId?.()
+						? { ownerSession: ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId() as string }
+						: {}),
+				});
+				const outcome = report.outcomes[0];
+				if (!outcome) {
+					// acceptIntake 一条请求必得一个 outcome；到这里说明契约被破坏，如实报不编造
+					return toolError("受理结果缺失：受理入口没有返回任何结果（一条请求应有且仅有一条结果，请查受理模块）");
+				}
+				// §5.4：停止/重派后旧受理结果不能当成功——只在真的给出身份时才查（没卡就无所谓失效）
+				let stale: boolean | undefined;
+				if (outcome.cardNo !== undefined || outcome.cardPath !== undefined) {
+					try {
+						stale = isIntakeOutcomeStale(outcome, cardsDir);
+					} catch {
+						stale = undefined;
+					}
+				}
+				const text = formatIntakeOutcome(outcome, { cardsDir, autoKey, stale, requestKey });
+				return {
+					content: [{ type: "text", text }],
+					details: {
+						status: outcome.status,
+						card_no: outcome.cardNo,
+						attempt: outcome.attempt,
+						request_key: requestKey,
+						auto_key: autoKey,
+						partial: report.partial,
+					},
+					// 只有「没受理」才是错误；deferred 是受理成功但没派，不算错误
+					isError: outcome.status === "rejected" ? true : undefined,
+				};
+			} catch (e) {
+				return toolError(`受理过程出错：${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
+			}
+		},
+	};
+}

+/**
+ * 已终结的卡(canceled/failed/delivered)。只报卡面事实,不读受理账:

+const settledStatus = new Set(["canceled", "failed", "delivered"]);

+/**
+ * 终态卡分区默认只报最近 5 张。理由:
+ * 1. 这个分区的用途是"我刚停的那张卡去哪了"——一次操作只涉及一两张,5 张足够覆盖近因;
+ * 2. 盘点是监督面不是全量报表,条数无限增长会把真正的未完卡挤到看不见的地方;
+ * 3. 需要全量时给的是真实可行的下一步(按文件路径自己翻),不是假装全量。
+ */
+const SETTLED_CARD_LIMIT = 5;
+
+/** owner记录段单条原因摘要上限(字符);盘点是监督面,不朗读全文。 */
+const SETTLED_REASON_MAX = 80;
+
+/** 取正文里最后一段 `## owner记录 <时间>` 的时间与原因摘要(状态迁移时才写)。 */
+function lastOwnerNote(body: string): { 时间?: string; 原因摘要: string } {
+	const lines = body.split("\n");
+	let start = -1;
+	let 时间: string | undefined;
+	for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+		const m = /^##\s*owner记录\s*(.*)$/.exec(lines[i].trim());
+		if (m) {
+			start = i;
+			时间 = m[1].trim() || undefined;
+		}
+	}
+	if (start === -1) return { 原因摘要: "" };
+	const picked: string[] = [];
+	for (let i = start + 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
+		const line = lines[i].trim();
+		if (/^#{1,6}\s/.test(line)) break;
+		if (!line) continue;
+		// 优先"依据"——人停止卡时写的就是理由;没有依据就退回其余条目
+		const m = /^[-*]\s*依据[:：]\s*(.+)$/.exec(line);
+		if (m) {
+			picked.unshift(m[1].trim());
+			continue;
+		}
+		if (/^[-*]\s*/.test(line)) picked.push(line.replace(/^[-*]\s*/, ""));
+	}
+	const text = picked.join("；");
+	return { 时间, 原因摘要: text.length > SETTLED_REASON_MAX ? `${text.slice(0, SETTLED_REASON_MAX)}…` : text };
+}
+
+/** 把 `2026-10-17 11:43` / ISO 串解析成毫秒;解析不出返回 0(排序时垫底,不编造时间)。 */
+function parseTime(value: string | undefined): number {
+	if (!value) return 0;
+	const normalized = value.includes("T") ? value : value.replace(" ", "T");
+	const ms = Date.parse(normalized);
+	return Number.isFinite(ms) ? ms : 0;
+}

+function oneLine(text: string, max = 120): string {
+	const line =
+		text
+			.split(/\r?\n/)
+			.map((value) => value.trim())
+			.find(Boolean) ?? "";
+	return line.length > max ? `${line.slice(0, max)}…` : line;

+/**
+ * 盘点卡摘要渲染。数据仍来自 InventoryReport 与卡文件；默认压缩监督面，
+ * full=true 才展开完整目标与最近回执。卡路径始终保留，供按需读取原卡。
+ */
+export function renderInventoryCards(
+	report: Pick<InventoryReport, "未完卡" | "已终结卡" | "已终结卡截断">,
+	options: InventoryRenderOptions = {},
+): string {
+	const full = options.full === true;
+	const lines: string[] = [];
+	if (report.未完卡.length === 0) {
+		lines.push("- 未完卡:无");
+	} else {
+		lines.push(`- 未完卡 ${report.未完卡.length} 张:`);
+		for (const card of report.未完卡) {
+			const goal = full ? card.目标 : oneLine(card.目标);
+			lines.push(
+				`  · 卡${card.卡号}〔卡状态:${card.状态};当前尝试 ${card.尝试} 有效回执:${card.当前尝试回执结果};最近收到的回执:${card.最近收到回执结果}(可能来自历史尝试)〕:${goal}`,
+			);
+			if (full) {
+				lines.push("    正文最后回执摘要(可能来自历史尝试):");
+				for (const line of card.最后回执摘要.split("\n")) lines.push(`    ${line}`);
+			} else {
+				lines.push(`    最近回执摘要:${oneLine(card.最后回执摘要)}`);
+			}
+			lines.push(`    原卡:${card.文件}${full ? "" : "(需要完整目标和回执时按此路径读取)"}`);
+		}
+	}
+	// 终态卡分区(E5 补「查回」闭环):没有终态卡就整段不输出——输出「终态卡:无」只让
+	// 回执变长而信息为零。只报卡面事实,判不出「这条受理是被 dup 还是被停」(见 已知边界.md)。
+	if (report.已终结卡.length > 0) {
+		lines.push(`- 已终结卡 ${report.已终结卡.length} 张(最近在前;卡面事实,不查受理账):`);
+		for (const card of report.已终结卡) {
+			const when = card.终结时间 ? ` ${card.终结时间}` : "";
+			const goal = full ? card.目标 : oneLine(card.目标);
+			lines.push(`  · 卡${card.卡号}〔${card.状态}〕${when}:${goal}`);
+			if (card.原因摘要) lines.push(`    原因:${card.原因摘要}`);
+			lines.push(`    原卡:${card.文件}${full ? "" : "(需要完整内容时按此路径读取)"}`);
+		}
+		if (report.已终结卡截断 > 0) {
+			lines.push(
+				`  另有 ${report.已终结卡截断} 张已终结卡未列出(本轮只报最近 ${report.已终结卡.length} 张)。要看全量请直接列 卡 目录下的 .md 卡文件,按 frontmatter 的 status 过滤 canceled/failed/delivered。`,
+			);
+		}
+	}
+	return lines.join("\n");
 }

+function appendLog(file: string, event: Record<string, unknown>): void {
+	try {
+		mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
+		appendFileSync(file, `${JSON.stringify({ type: "pao_dispatch_lock", time: utcNow(), ...event })}\n`, "utf8");
+	} catch (error) {
+		const errorCode =
+			(error as NodeJS.ErrnoException | undefined)?.code !== undefined
+				? ` code=${(error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code}`
+				: "";
+		const nestedCause =
+			error instanceof Error && error.cause !== undefined
+				? ` cause=${error.cause instanceof Error ? error.cause.message : String(error.cause)}`
+				: "";
+		logWarn(
+			`[pao] 派发锁日志写入失败（互斥仍按现场继续，审计记录缺失）:${file}:${
+				error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
+			}${errorCode}${nestedCause}`,
+		);

+export async function acquireExecutionRootGuard(options: ExecutionRootGuardOptions): Promise<ExecutionRootGuard> {
+	const taskRoot = await canonicalDir(options.taskRoot, "任务根");
+	const requestedExecutionRoot = path.resolve(options.executionRoot);
+	const executionRoot = await canonicalDir(requestedExecutionRoot, "执行根");
+	if (pathKey(taskRoot) === pathKey(executionRoot))
+		throw new PaoWorkerError("无效参数", "执行根与任务根相同，没有可独立清理的任务根侧守卫");
+	const guardDir = path.join(taskRoot, ".pao", "执行根守卫");
+	await mkdir(guardDir, { recursive: true });
+	const guardPath = path.join(guardDir, `${executionRootGuardName(executionRoot)}.json`);
+	await writeFile(guardPath, "", { flag: "a" });
+	const logPath = options.logPath ? path.resolve(options.logPath) : dispatchLockLogPath(taskRoot);
+	const holder = options.holder.trim();
+	if (!holder) throw new PaoWorkerError("无效参数", "执行根守卫持有者不能为空");
+	appendLog(logPath, {
+		action: "guard_wait",
+		kind: "cleanup",
+		taskRoot,
+		executionRoot,
+		guardPath,
+		holder,
+	});
+	let releaseLease: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined;
+	try {
+		releaseLease = await lockfile.lock(guardPath, {
+			realpath: false,
+			stale: DISPATCH_LOCK_LEASE_MS,
+			update: DISPATCH_LOCK_HEARTBEAT_MS,
+			retries: { retries: 0 },
+			onCompromised: (error) => {
+				appendLog(logPath, {
+					action: "guard_lease_compromised",
+					kind: "cleanup",
+					taskRoot,
+					executionRoot,
+					guardPath,
+					holder,
+					error: error.message,
+				});
+			},
+		});
+		options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
+		const canonicalAgain = await realpath(requestedExecutionRoot);
+		if (pathKey(canonicalAgain) !== pathKey(executionRoot))
+			throw new PaoWorkerError("锁被占用", "执行根在守卫获取期间被替换，拒绝继续", {
+				expected: executionRoot,
+				actual: canonicalAgain,
+			});
+		const occupancy = await detectExecutionOccupancy(executionRoot);
+		let released = false;
+		const guard: ExecutionRootGuard = {
+			taskRoot,
+			executionRoot,
+			holder,
+			acquiredAt: utcNow(),
+			occupancy,
+			async release() {
+				const record = pendingGuards.get(guard);
+				if (!record) throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "执行根守卫句柄无效或已释放");
+				if (record.released) return;
+				try {
+					await record.release();
+					record.released = true;
+					released = true;
+					pendingGuards.delete(guard);
+					appendLog(record.logPath, {
+						action: "guard_released",
+						kind: "cleanup",
+						taskRoot,
+						executionRoot,
+						guardPath,
+						holder,
+					});
+				} finally {
+					// 释放失败时 pendingGuards 保留句柄，下一次 release 会重试。
+				}
+			},
+		};
+		pendingGuards.set(guard, {
+			release: releaseLease!,
+			released,
+			logPath,
+			guardPath,
+		});
+		releaseLease = undefined;
+		appendLog(logPath, {
+			action: "guard_acquired",
+			kind: "cleanup",
+			taskRoot,
+			executionRoot,
+			guardPath,
+			holder,
+			occupancy,
+		});
+		return guard;
+	} catch (error) {
+		if (releaseLease) {
+			try {
+				await releaseLease();
+			} catch (releaseError) {
+				appendLog(logPath, {
+					action: "guard_acquire_rollback_failed",
+					kind: "cleanup",
+					taskRoot,
+					executionRoot,
+					guardPath,
+					holder,
+					error: releaseError instanceof Error ? releaseError.message : String(releaseError),
+				});
+				throw new PaoWorkerError("锁被占用", "执行根守卫获取后回滚失败，保留失败现场", {
+					guardPath,
+					cause: releaseError instanceof Error ? releaseError.message : String(releaseError),
+					originalError: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+				});
+			}
+		}
+		appendLog(logPath, {
+			action: "guard_acquire_failed",
+			kind: "cleanup",
+			taskRoot,
+			executionRoot,
+			guardPath,
+			holder,
+			error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+		});
+		if (isLockHeldError(error))
+			throw new PaoWorkerError("锁被占用", `执行根已有清理或占用守卫:${guardPath}`, {
+				guardPath,
+				cause: String(error),
+			});

+	}

+/**
+ * 正常停止后的受管运行元数据处置。
+ *
+ * 调用方必须先持 executionRoot guard，并在调用前再次确认 occupancy 为 idle。
+ * 只归档本实现创建的锁标记和派发日志，不递归删除 .pao，不碰其他文件；
+ * 任一复制、目标校验或原始文件删除失败都保留 guard 和现有文件，调用方不得继续删执行根。
+ */
+export async function prepareExecutionRootForRemoval(
+	options: PrepareExecutionRootForRemovalOptions,
+): Promise<readonly ReleasedExecutionArtifact[]> {
+	options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
+	const record = pendingGuards.get(options.guard);
+	if (!record || record.released) throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "执行根 guard 无效或已释放");
+	const occupancy = await detectExecutionOccupancy(options.guard.executionRoot);
+	if (occupancy !== "idle")
+		throw new PaoWorkerError("锁被占用", `执行根占用状态不是 idle，拒绝处置运行元数据:${occupancy}`);
+	const taskRoot = await canonicalDir(options.guard.taskRoot, "任务根");
+	const requestedArchiveRoot = path.resolve(options.archiveRoot);
+	await mkdir(path.dirname(requestedArchiveRoot), { recursive: true });
+	const archiveParent = await canonicalDir(path.dirname(requestedArchiveRoot), "运行证据归档父目录");
+	const archiveRoot = path.join(archiveParent, path.basename(requestedArchiveRoot));
+	if (!isPathInside(taskRoot, archiveRoot) || isPathInside(options.guard.executionRoot, archiveRoot))
+		throw new PaoWorkerError("无效参数", "运行证据归档目录必须位于任务根内、执行根外", {
+			taskRoot,
+			executionRoot: options.guard.executionRoot,
+			archiveRoot,
 		});
+	await mkdir(archiveRoot, { recursive: true });
+	const paoDir = path.join(options.guard.executionRoot, ".pao");
+	const candidates: { kind: ReleasedExecutionArtifact["kind"]; path: string }[] = [
+		{ kind: "lock-marker", path: path.join(paoDir, LOCK_META.execution.marker) },
+		{ kind: "lock-directory", path: `${path.join(paoDir, LOCK_META.execution.marker)}.lock` },
+		{ kind: "dispatch-log", path: path.join(paoDir, "派发日志.jsonl") },
+	];
+	const result: ReleasedExecutionArtifact[] = [];
+	for (const candidate of candidates) {
+		options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
+		if (!existsSync(candidate.path)) continue;
+		if (candidate.kind === "lock-directory") {
+			// 只在占用状态已明确 idle 且目录为空时删除；未知内容保留，交给人工盘点。
+			try {
+				await rmdir(candidate.path);
+				appendLog(record.logPath, {
+					action: "execution_runtime_artifact_removed",
+					kind: "cleanup",
+					executionRoot: options.guard.executionRoot,
+					guardPath: record.guardPath,
+					artifact: candidate,
+				});
+				result.push({ ...candidate, action: "removed" });
+			} catch (error) {
+				const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
+				if (code === "ENOENT") continue;
+				result.push({ ...candidate, action: "retained" });
+				throw new PaoWorkerError("停止失败", `锁目录非空或无法安全移除，保留现场:${candidate.path}`, {
+					artifacts: result,
+					cause: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+				});
+			}
+			continue;
+		}
+		const archivedPath = path.join(archiveRoot, `${candidate.kind}-${executionRootGuardName(options.guard.executionRoot)}`);
+		try {
+			const existing = existsSync(archivedPath) ? await readFile(archivedPath, "utf8") : "";
+			const content = await readFile(candidate.path, "utf8");
+			if (existing && existing !== content)
+				throw new PaoWorkerError("无效参数", "运行元数据归档目标已有不同内容，拒绝覆盖", {
+					source: candidate.path,
+					archive: archivedPath,
+				});
+			if (!existing) await writeFile(archivedPath, content, { encoding: "utf8", flag: "wx" });
+			const archived = await readFile(archivedPath, "utf8");
+			if (archived !== content)
+				throw new PaoWorkerError("无效参数", "运行元数据归档后内容不一致，保留原文件", {
+					source: candidate.path,
+					archive: archivedPath,
+				});
+			await rm(candidate.path);
+			result.push({ ...candidate, action: "archived", archivedPath });
+		} catch (error) {
+			result.push({ ...candidate, action: "retained" });
+			throw new PaoWorkerError("停止失败", `运行元数据处置失败，保留全部现场:${candidate.path}`, {
+				artifacts: result,
+				cause: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+			});
+		}
+	}
+	// 锁文件用于 proper-lockfile 的兄弟锁目录，正常释放后可能仍留一个空 marker；
+	// 上面的非递归删除已处理。其它 .pao 内容不在此处猜测所有权。
+	appendLog(record.logPath, {
+		action: "execution_runtime_artifacts_prepared",
+		kind: "cleanup",
+		taskRoot,
+		executionRoot: options.guard.executionRoot,
+		guardPath: record.guardPath,
+		artifacts: result,
+	});
+	return result;
+}

+function isPathInside(parent: string, child: string): boolean {
+	const normalizedParent = path.resolve(parent).replace(/[\\/]+$/, "");
+	const normalizedChild = path.resolve(child);
+	const relative = path.relative(normalizedParent, normalizedChild);
+	return relative === "" || (!relative.startsWith("..") && !path.isAbsolute(relative));
+}

+async function acquire(
+	kind: DispatchLockKind,
+	options: AcquireLockOptions,
+	details: Record<string, unknown> = {},
+): Promise<DispatchWriteLock> {
+	const normalized = normalizeOptions(options);
+	const root = await canonicalDir(normalized.root, kind === "execution" ? "执行根" : "任务根");
+	const paoDir = path.join(root, ".pao");
+	const logPath = normalized.logPath ? path.resolve(normalized.logPath) : dispatchLockLogPath(root);
+	const meta = LOCK_META[kind];
+	const lockPath = path.join(paoDir, meta.marker);
+	await mkdir(paoDir, { recursive: true });
+	await writeFile(lockPath, "", { flag: "a" });
+	const requestedAt = utcNow();
+	let reservationPath: string | undefined;
+	appendLog(logPath, {
+		action: "wait",
+		kind,
+		root,
+		lockPath,
+		holder: normalized.holder,
+		retries: normalized.retries,
+		requestedAt,
+		...details,
+	});
+
+	let release: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined;
+	let acquired = false;
+	let reservationCreationDeferred = false;
+	try {
+		if (kind === "execution") {
+			// 同根排队时先等租约，避免把前序持有者的持久占位误判为崩溃残留。
+			// 仍保持 execution -> reservation 的创建顺序，前序未正常释放时占位继续阻止抢入。
+			if (normalized.wait) {
+				release = await lockfile.lock(lockPath, {
+					realpath: false,
+					stale: DISPATCH_LOCK_LEASE_MS,
+					update: DISPATCH_LOCK_HEARTBEAT_MS,
+					retries: {
+						retries: normalized.retries === 0 ? 60 : normalized.retries,
+						minTimeout: 100,
+						maxTimeout: 1000,
+						factor: 2,
+						randomize: false,
+					},
+				});
+				acquired = true;
+				normalized.signal?.throwIfAborted();
+				reservationCreationDeferred = true;
+			}
+			if (!reservationCreationDeferred)
+			reservationPath = await createExecutionReservation(paoDir, {
+				root,
+				holder: normalized.holder,
+				acquiredAt: utcNow(),
+			});
+		}
+		if (!release) {
+			release = await lockfile.lock(lockPath, {
+				realpath: false,
+				stale: DISPATCH_LOCK_LEASE_MS,
+				update: DISPATCH_LOCK_HEARTBEAT_MS,
+				retries: {
+					retries: normalized.retries,
+					minTimeout: 100,
+					maxTimeout: 1000,
+					factor: 2,
+					randomize: false,
+				},
+			});
+			acquired = true;
+			normalized.signal?.throwIfAborted();
+		}
+		if (reservationCreationDeferred) {
+			reservationPath = await createExecutionReservation(paoDir, {
+				root,
+				holder: normalized.holder,
+				acquiredAt: utcNow(),
+			});
+		}
 	} catch (error) {
+		if (acquired && release) {
+			try {
+				await release();
+				release = undefined;
+				acquired = false;
+			} catch (releaseError) {
+				appendLog(logPath, {
+					action: "acquire_rollback_failed",
+					kind,
+					root,
+					lockPath,
+					holder: normalized.holder,
+					error: releaseError instanceof Error ? releaseError.message : String(releaseError),
+					...details,
+				});
+				throw new PaoWorkerError(
+					"锁被占用",
+					`锁获取后取消，但租约回滚失败；拒绝留下谎称已释放的锁:${lockPath}`,
+					{
+						kind,
+						锁路径: lockPath,
+						cause: releaseError instanceof Error ? releaseError.message : String(releaseError),
+					},
+				);
+			}
+		}
+		if (reservationPath) {
+			try {
+				await rm(reservationPath, { force: true });
+			} catch (cleanupError) {
+				appendLog(logPath, {
+					action: "acquire_reservation_cleanup_failed",
+					kind,
+					root,
+					lockPath,
+					reservationPath,
+					error: cleanupError instanceof Error ? cleanupError.message : String(cleanupError),
+					...details,
+				});
+				throw new PaoWorkerError(
+					"锁被占用",
+					`锁获取失败且持久占位未清理，按 fail-closed 保留现场:${reservationPath}`,
+					{

+						原始错误: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+					},
+				);
+			}
+		}
+		appendLog(logPath, {
+			action: "acquire_failed",
+			kind,
+			root,
+			lockPath,
+			holder: normalized.holder,
+			error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+			...details,
+		});
 		if (isLockHeldError(error)) {
-			throw new PaoWorkerError("锁被占用", `项目写锁被占用:${lockPath}`, { 锁路径: lockPath, cause: String(error) });
+			throw new PaoWorkerError(

+				`${kind === "execution" ? "执行根" : "任务根"}${kind === "execution" ? "执行" : "共享"}锁被占用:${lockPath}`,
+				{ kind, 锁路径: lockPath, cause: String(error) },
+			);
 		}

 	}
-	const lock: ProjectWriteLock = {
-		项目根: projectRoot,
-		锁路径: lockPath,
-		持有者: options.持有者,

+	const lock: DispatchWriteLock = {
+		kind,

+		acquiredAt: utcNow(),

+		release,

+		...(reservationPath ? { reservationPath } : {}),
+	});

+		action: "acquired",
+		kind,
+		root,
+		lockPath,
+		holder: normalized.holder,
+		acquiredAt: lock.acquiredAt,
+		waitedMs: Date.parse(lock.acquiredAt) - Date.parse(requestedAt),
+		...details,

+/** 按 executionRoot 取长锁；租约心跳之外另受不会自动过期的持久占位保护。 */
+export function acquireExecutionLock(options: AcquireLockOptions): Promise<DispatchWriteLock> {
+	return acquire("execution", options);
+}

+/** 按 taskRoot 取短事务锁；调用方必须把持锁区间收窄到状态读写，不得覆盖 runner 全程。 */
+export function acquireSharedLock(options: AcquireLockOptions): Promise<DispatchWriteLock> {
+	return acquire("shared", options);

 /**

- * 「先停后放锁」由此在类型与运行期双重强制。

+export function acquireProjectLock(options: AcquireLockOptions): Promise<ProjectWriteLock> {

+
+export async function releaseDispatchLock(
+	lock: DispatchWriteLock,
+	proof: StopProof,
+	details: Record<string, unknown> = {},
+): Promise<void> {
+	if (!(proof instanceof StopProof)) {
+		throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "释放派发锁必须出示运行器签发的停止确认凭据(先停后放锁)");
+	}
+	if (lock.kind !== "execution") {
+		throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "共享锁是短事务锁，应使用 releaseSharedLock 释放");
+	}
+	const record = pending.get(lock);
+	if (!record) {
+		throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "锁句柄无效或已释放", { 锁路径: lock.lockPath });
+	}
+	try {
+		if (record.releaseState === "lease-held") {
+			if (!record.release) {
+				throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "执行锁缺少租约释放句柄，保留占位等待人工处理", {
+					锁路径: lock.lockPath,
+				});
+			}
+			const release = record.release;
+			await release();
+			record.release = undefined;
+			record.releaseState = "lease-released";
+		}
+		if (record.reservationPath) await rm(record.reservationPath, { force: true });
+		record.reservationPath = undefined;
+		pending.delete(lock);
+		appendLog(record.logPath, {
+			action: "released",
+			kind: lock.kind,
+			root: lock.root,
+			lockPath: lock.lockPath,
+			holder: lock.holder,
+			acquiredAt: lock.acquiredAt,
+			releasedAt: utcNow(),
+			stoppedProcesses: proof.stoppedProcesses.map((item) => item.pid),
+			...(record.retainReason ? { retainReason: record.retainReason } : {}),
+			...(record.retainDetails ? { retainDetails: record.retainDetails } : {}),
+			...details,
+		});
+	} catch (error) {
+		// 分阶段状态保存在句柄里：租约成功释放后不会再释放一次；重试只做尚未完成的占位删除。
+		pending.set(lock, record);
+		appendLog(record.logPath, {
+			action: "release_failed",
+			kind: lock.kind,
+			root: lock.root,
+			lockPath: lock.lockPath,
+			holder: lock.holder,
+			error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+			...details,
+		});
+		throw error;
+	}
+}
+
+/** 共享锁只覆盖短事务，不需要进程停止凭据。 */
+export async function releaseSharedLock(lock: DispatchWriteLock): Promise<void> {
+	if (lock.kind !== "shared") {
+		throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "执行长锁必须凭 StopProof 释放");
+	}
+	const record = pending.get(lock);
+	if (!record) throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "锁句柄无效或已释放", { 锁路径: lock.lockPath });
+	try {
+		if (record.releaseState === "lease-released") {
+			pending.delete(lock);
+			return;
+		}
+		if (!record.release) {
+			throw new PaoWorkerError("无效凭据", "共享锁缺少租约释放句柄，句柄保持占用", {
+				锁路径: lock.lockPath,
+			});
+		}
+		const release = record.release;
+		await release();
+		record.release = undefined;
+		record.releaseState = "lease-released";
+		pending.delete(lock);
+		appendLog(record.logPath, {
+			action: "released",
+			kind: lock.kind,
+			root: lock.root,
+			lockPath: lock.lockPath,
+			holder: lock.holder,
+			acquiredAt: lock.acquiredAt,
+			releasedAt: utcNow(),
+			...(record.retainReason ? { retainReason: record.retainReason } : {}),
+			...(record.retainDetails ? { retainDetails: record.retainDetails } : {}),
+		});
+	} catch (error) {
+		pending.set(lock, record);
+		appendLog(record.logPath, {
+			action: "release_failed",
+			kind: lock.kind,
+			root: lock.root,
+			lockPath: lock.lockPath,
+			holder: lock.holder,
+			error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+		});
+		throw error;
+	}
+}

+async function isLocked(rootValue: string, kind: DispatchLockKind, label?: string): Promise<boolean> {
+	const root = await canonicalDir(rootValue, label ?? (kind === "execution" ? "执行根" : "任务根"));
+	const paoDir = path.join(root, ".pao");
+	if (kind === "execution" && existsSync(path.join(paoDir, EXECUTION_RESERVATION))) return true;
+	const lockPath = path.join(paoDir, LOCK_META[kind].marker);
+	return lockfile.check(lockPath, { realpath: false, stale: DISPATCH_LOCK_LEASE_MS });
+}
+
+export function isExecutionLocked(executionRoot: string): Promise<boolean> {
+	return isLocked(executionRoot, "execution");
+}
+
+export function isSharedLocked(taskRoot: string): Promise<boolean> {
+	return isLocked(taskRoot, "shared");
+}
+
+/** 旧查询兼容：查任务根共享锁。 */
+export function isProjectLocked(projectRoot: string): Promise<boolean> {
+	return isLocked(projectRoot, "shared", "项目根");
+}
+
+/** 测试和初始化工具用：显式写入标记文件，不获取锁。 */
+export function ensureDispatchLockMarker(root: string, kind: DispatchLockKind): string {
+	const paoDir = path.join(root, ".pao");
+	mkdirSync(paoDir, { recursive: true });
+	const marker = path.join(paoDir, LOCK_META[kind].marker);
+	writeFileSync(marker, "", { flag: "a" });
+	return marker;
 }

+function legacyStrictReceiptBody(text: string): string {
+	return text
+		.trim()
+		.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*\n?/, "")
+		.replace(/\n?```$/, "");
+}
+
+/**
+ * 正式派发只采信最后一条助手消息中的 JSON 回执；退出码 0 本身不代表完成。
+ * 为避免放宽正式契约，保留“说明包着 JSON”仍拒收；恢复走 diagnoseWorkerFinalReceipt。
+ */
+export function parseWorkerFinalResult(text: string, cwd: string): WorkerFinalResult {
+	return parseJsonReceiptBody(legacyStrictReceiptBody(text), cwd);
+}
+
+/**
+ * 回执格式诊断：正式解析失败时，仅接受“说明文字 + 唯一完整 ```json 围栏 + 说明文字”。
+ * runner 仅在同一 dispatch、首次落回执前使用该结果；它本身不改卡状态，也不代替机械验收。
+ */
+export function diagnoseWorkerFinalReceipt(text: string, cwd: string): WorkerFinalReceiptDiagnostic {
+	let strictError: string;
+	try {
+		return {
+			kind: "strict",
+			parsed: parseWorkerFinalResult(text, cwd),
+			rawText: text,
+			receiptText: legacyStrictReceiptBody(text),
+		};
+	} catch (error) {
+		strictError = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
+	}
+	const fenceStarts = [...text.matchAll(/```json[ \t]*(?:\r?\n|$)/gi)];
+	const fenceEnds = [...text.matchAll(/(?:^|\r?\n)```[ \t]*(?=\r?\n|$)/g)];
+	if (fenceStarts.length !== 1 || fenceEnds.length !== 1) {
+		throw new Error(`最终回执格式不唯一：严格解析失败（${strictError}），且未找到唯一完整 json 围栏`);
+	}
+	const start = fenceStarts[0]!;
+	const end = fenceEnds[0]!;
+	const fenceStart = start.index! + start[0].length;
+	const fenceEnd = end.index! + (end[0].startsWith("\r\n") ? 2 : end[0].startsWith("\n") ? 1 : 0);
+	if (fenceEnd < fenceStart) throw new Error(`最终回执围栏顺序损坏（${strictError}）`);
+	const receiptText = text.slice(fenceStart, fenceEnd).trim();
+	let parsed: WorkerFinalResult;
+	try {
+		parsed = parseJsonReceiptBody(receiptText, cwd);
+	} catch (error) {
+		throw new Error(
+			`最终回执围栏内容未通过严格 schema（${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}；严格解析原错误：${strictError}）`,
+		);
+	}
+	return { kind: "fenced", parsed, rawText: text, receiptText, strictError };
+}

+	async #readSlotReservations(
+		root: string,
+	): Promise<{ 身份: string; 部门: string | null; occupancy: "known" | "unknown" }[]> {
+		let names: string[];
+		try {
+			names = await readdir(root);
+		} catch (error) {
+			if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return [];
+			throw error;
+		}
+		const live: { 身份: string; 部门: string | null; occupancy: "known" | "unknown" }[] = [];
+		for (const name of names.filter((item) => item.endsWith(".json"))) {
+			const file = path.join(root, name);
+			try {
+				const value = JSON.parse(await readFile(file, "utf8")) as {
+					身份?: unknown;
+					部门?: unknown;
+				};
+				if (typeof value.身份 !== "string" || !value.身份.trim()) throw new Error(`预约缺少有效身份:${file}`);
+				live.push({
+					身份: executionKey(value.身份),
+					部门: typeof value.部门 === "string" ? value.部门 : null,
+					occupancy: "known",
+				});
+			} catch (error) {
+				if (
+					error instanceof SyntaxError ||
+					(error instanceof Error && error.message.startsWith("预约缺少有效身份"))
+				) {
+					live.push({ 身份: `未知占位:${name}`, 部门: null, occupancy: "unknown" });
+					continue;
+				}
+				throw error;
+			}
+		}
+		return live;
+	}

+	const promise = Promise.resolve(pending);
+	const signal = options.signal;
+	if (!signal) return promise;
+	if (signal.aborted) return Promise.reject(signal.reason);
+	return new Promise<AutoChainReviewDecision>((resolve, reject) => {
+		const onAbort = () => {
+			cleanup();
+			reject(signal.reason ?? new Error("自动链审核等待已取消"));
+		};
+		const cleanup = () => signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
+		signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
+		void promise.then(
+			(decision) => {
+				cleanup();
+				resolve(decision);
+			},
+			(error: unknown) => {
+				cleanup();
+				reject(error);
+			},
+		);
+	});
+}

+/**
+ * 自动链停因追加到控制正本已有审计记录。只在实例未完成时写；内容不变则幂等，
+ * 不改变 运行中/挂起/已完成 状态，也不推进节点或轮次。
+ */
+export async function recordControlStopReason(
+	recipe: WorkflowRecipe,
+	options: DriverOptions,
+	stop: { reason: string; 节点?: string; 轮次?: number },
+): Promise<void> {
+	await mutate(recipe, options, (flow) => {
+		const reason = stop.reason.trim();
+		if (!reason) fail("自动链停因不能为空");
+		if (flow.状态 === "已完成") return;
+		const latest = [...flow.记录].reverse().find((record) => record.事件 === "自动链停因");
+		if (latest?.理由 === reason && latest.节点 === stop.节点 && latest.轮次 === stop.轮次) return;
+		flow.记录.push({
+			时间: new Date().toISOString(),
+			事件: "自动链停因",
+			...(stop.节点 !== undefined ? { 节点: stop.节点 } : {}),
+			...(stop.轮次 !== undefined ? { 轮次: stop.轮次 } : {}),
+			理由: reason,
+		});
+	});

+	/** 把卡实际所属节点路由到其绑定部长；自动链只负责 worker 结果，不越级交给主控。 */
+	#receiptTarget(flow: FlowControl, cardRef: string): { node: string; minister: string } {
+		const matches = flow.节点
+			.map((node) => ({
+				node,
+				def: flow.冻结配方.节点.find((candidate) => candidate.名字 === node.名字),

+					: `卡${cardRef}回执同时命中 ${matches.length} 个部长，身份有歧义，拒绝投递`,
+			);
+		return { node: matches[0].node.名字, minister: matches[0].node.部长会话! };
+	}
